title: Counit pullback scalar comparison in normalized word coordinates
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and finite extensions $E\subset L$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ in a fixed algebraic closure, allowing equality, with valuation rings $\mathcal O_F$, uniformizers $\varpi_F$, and $A_{F,n}=\mathcal O_F/\varpi_F^n$ for $F=E,L$ and $n\geq1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $g:X\to Y$ be a scheme isomorphism, with $\ell$ invertible on both schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. On the small pro-etale site of $W=X,Y$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], set $B_{F,W,n}=(A_{F,n})_W$ and $R_{F,W}=\lim_n B_{F,W,n}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Work in the ambient derived categories of these completed-ring module sheaves [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and let $K\in\mathcal C_E(Y)=D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ be constructible and derived complete [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]. Write $\widehat U_{g,F}=Lg_F^*$ for completed integral pullback [def-pur-integral-derived-operations] and $\widehat S_W=T_{L/E,W}$ for completed integral scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension].

Let $\mathscr S_F(W)$ be the category of strict quotient-module systems with quotient-linear transitions, $\mathcal R_{F,W}$ its simultaneous derived reduction functor, $\mathcal L_{F,W}=R\lim\operatorname{Res}$ its realization functor, and $e:\mathcal R\mathcal L\to1$ the entire-system counit [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. A system is normalized if its transition-adjoint maps $C_m\otimes^L_{B_{F,W,m}}B_{F,W,n}\to C_n$ are isomorphisms for $m\geq n$ [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower]. Use the whole-system operations $U_{g,F}$ and $S_W=S_{L/E,W}$ and their specified scalar/pullback comparison $\kappa:S_XU_{g,E}\xrightarrow{\sim}U_{g,L}S_Y$ [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems]. Put
$$C=\mathcal R_{E,Y}K,\qquad A=S_XU_{g,E}C,\qquad B=U_{g,L}S_YC.$$

There exist simultaneous realization models with exactly the quotient-generator and K-injective-counit normalization of [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models]. For every flat-term K-flat representative $P\to K$ [lem-pc-kflat-resolution], they use the simultaneous quotients $P_{F,n}=P\otimes_{R_{E,Y}}B_{F,Y,n}$ and $Q=P\otimes_{R_{E,Y}}R_{L,Y}$, with the actual quotient transitions and balanced reassociation $(x\otimes a)\otimes b\mapsto x\otimes ab$. Their initial completion maps are quotient augmentations with zero shifted Roos coordinate. The systems $C,U_{g,E}C,S_YC,A,B$ are normalized, all their intermediate realizations are constructible and derived complete, their entire-system counits are invertible, and $K\to\mathcal L_{E,Y}C$ is invertible.

For primitive operations $O$, write $b_{O,H}:\widehat OH\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal LO\mathcal RH$ for the prescribed normalized realization isomorphisms and put
$$r_{O,D}=\mathcal L(O(e_D))\circ b_{O,\mathcal LD}.$$
Define the two word coordinates by
$$\beta_A=r_{S_X,U_{g,E}C}\circ\widehat S_X(b_{U_{g,E},K}),\qquad
\beta_B=r_{U_{g,L},S_YC}\circ\widehat U_{g,L}(b_{S_Y,K}).$$
Thus $\beta_A:\widehat S_X\widehat U_{g,E}K\to\mathcal L_{L,X}A$ and $\beta_B:\widehat U_{g,L}\widehat S_YK\to\mathcal L_{L,X}B$.

The maps $\beta_A,\beta_B$ are natural isomorphisms. For the specified whole-system counit comparison
$$a_{g,K}=\mu_{g,K}^{-1}\circ\lambda_{g,K}$$
of [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization], they satisfy
$$\beta_B\circ a_{g,K}=\mathcal L_{L,X}(\kappa_C)\circ\beta_A.$$
Here $\lambda$ includes the balanced identification $(g^*P_{E,n})\otimes^L_{B_{E,X,n}}B_{L,X,n}\cong g^*P_{L,n}$, and $\mu$ uses the target word: both use the entire-system derived-limit counit, normalized by the ordinary limit cone on a K-injective tower resolution, at every intermediate realization. The displayed identity is an equality of derived morphisms obtained from whole quotient diagrams, with their transitions and tower homotopies retained. It is natural in $K$ and independent of representatives and resolutions through the canonical normalized comparisons. No finite Tor-amplitude hypothesis or flatness of $A_{E,n}\to A_{L,n}$ is imposed.

proof.text: Choose an ambient simultaneous comparison system using lem-trf-ambient-comparison-system-existence. For any allowed field and scheme, take the completion-normalized calculus and Roos model from lem-trf-effective-comparison-realization-models. The canonical left-adjoint uniqueness isomorphism identifies this reduction with the ambient system reduction. Its unit compatibility and the unit_projection formula identify the finite reductionEvaluation maps, so every coherent reduction presentation transfers to the normalized calculus with the same strict complex and finite identifications. Normalized Roos models agree: resolve any tower by a K-injective one and use naturality to extend their identical prescribed K-injective components. The transferred normalization supplies the same chain augmentation, quotient coordinates and zero shifted coordinates; unit compatibility proves its whole-morphism equation for the ambient calculus. Thus the ambient system satisfies the first existential conjunct.

proof.text: For a primitive O applied to any normalized C with constructible realization, the whole-system counit is invertible by lem-trf-counit-realization-substitution, so the defining r=b followed by L(O(e_C)) is invertible. The completed operation on L(C) is constructible by lem-pur-integral-operations-preserve-constructible or lem-weil-integral-scalar-extension-constructible. Transport constructibility across r. These two constructibility clauses verify Word.Allowed for the atom O; the word invertibility law gives normalization of O(C), and the counit law gives effectivity there. Apply this successively to U_E(C), S_Y(C), S_X(U_E(C)) and U_L(S_Y(C)), verifying all five required systems.

proof.text: Naturality of the scalar primitive realization at the pullback primitive realization gives beta_A=lambda.hom: expand both definitions, combine functor maps, and recognize the pullback whole-system counit. The identical calculation with the two primitives reversed gives beta_B=mu.hom followed by L(kappa). Both coordinates are isomorphisms. Since the specified a is lambda followed by mu inverse, cancellation proves a followed by beta_B = beta_A followed by L(kappa). This is an equality in the entire derived diagram realization, with no finite-evaluation faithfulness assertion.

proof.text: Each beta is the component of the composite natural transformation formed by whiskering the first primitive realization by the second completed functor, then the second primitive realization and the whole counit. Its naturality yields exactly both displayed coordinate equations for every full-subcategory morphism. This argument uses the supplied normalized models and actual counits; it introduces no representative choice, Tor bound, flatness hypothesis or restriction excluding zero inputs or equal coefficients.
